title: A Military ship in node_beta strips its off-role Mining Laser I (and an Ice Harvester I) docked at Node Beta Industrial Station into its storage there
note: Written by Apophis 2026-11-23 12:19 UTC (orders ENT-082, block APOPHIS: strip mining lasers, F17: stripping off-role starters deploys at once in parallel batches; scorecard trigger Module Fit & Purity: 130 of 130 Military ships carry a mining_laser_i, 8 also an ice_harvester_i, table ship_modules 12:08 UTC). A drone or sentinel mines nothing (F23); the laser takes cpu 2 and power 5 (catalog 0.734.0) that a second Shield Booster II or an armor plate uses. The copy of Zero's strip-pulse-laser-central-nexus form: one docked stop, unfit then store all, gated by requires.in_system (requires.docked_at refuses every pilot today, requests.log ENT-447), so only a ship already in the system takes it. The stored lasers are offered to Mining (requests.log), whose strip route buys a Mining Laser I at about 1,616 cr.
